authority.reason: F2-WP-1200, F2-WP-1201 and F2-WP-1202 already have active create-only mutation claims; this packet is review/falsifier evidence only.

observed_sources.semantic_anchor: MISSING_EVIDENCE != PASS; independent target readback; negative-space search; exact target profile generation/digest
UNKNOWN not PASS; no secret/user-content collection; counterevidence probe required

findings.observation: TARGET_OBLIGATION schema permits status=PASS with evidence_refs=[], with observed_at omitted, and with observed_target_generation omitted.
findings.risk: A schema-valid object can encode PASS without the mandatory evidence that the architecture says must otherwise resolve to UNKNOWN.
findings.required_falsifier: Validator test must reject PASS when mandatory positive evidence is absent, when counterevidence results are absent, when observed target generation is absent for target-bound evidence, or when evidence is below minimum_fidelity.
findings.credit_boundary: Schema validation alone must never grant completion credit.

findings.observation: TARGET_HOST_PROFILE schema defines redaction_policy but does not require it.
findings.risk: A profile can be schema-valid without an explicit machine-checkable assertion that credentials, clipboard, raw camera, raw microphone and user documents were excluded.
findings.required_falsifier: Collector/profile validator should require redaction_policy and all five false constants for any admitted TARGET_OBSERVED or MIXED profile; missing policy must fail closed or remain unadmitted.

findings.observation: The profile schema allows many target fields to be null/empty while unknown_fields is only a free list and is not structurally required to enumerate every unobserved field.
findings.risk: UNKNOWN can collapse into a null/default-looking value, violating the explicit rule that guessed/unobserved target facts remain UNKNOWN.
findings.required_falsifier: Deterministic collector/validator must prove a bidirectional invariant: every unobserved target fact is listed in unknown_fields, and every unknown_fields path resolves to an explicitly non-observed value; tests should mutate one side only and require rejection.

findings.observation: TARGET_OBLIGATION schema does not constrain consistency between minimum_fidelity and physical_required.
findings.risk: Contradictory combinations can be encoded and interpreted differently by workers, e.g. T4_PHYSICAL with physical_required=false.
findings.required_falsifier: Semantic validator should reject contradictory fidelity/physical combinations or define one canonical interpretation with tests.

findings.observation: target_profile_digest is regex-constrained but not semantically bound by schema to an admitted profile/generation; an all-zero or otherwise invented 64-hex digest is syntactically valid.
findings.risk: T0/T1 work could accidentally fabricate target identity instead of binding a real synthetic/observed profile artifact.
findings.required_falsifier: Completion evaluation must resolve target_profile_digest to an admitted profile object and verify the digest/generation. Unknown physical target facts require a synthetic/UNKNOWN-bearing profile, never an invented exact-target digest.

recommended_negative_tests: PASS + missing observed_target_generation on target-bound evidence => reject/UNKNOWN
TARGET_OBSERVED profile + missing redaction_policy => reject admission
profile null field not listed in unknown_fields => reject admission
unknown_fields entry whose value is presented as observed => reject admission
T4_PHYSICAL + physical_required=false => reject or canonicalize explicitly
counterhypothesis: WP-1200/WP-1201 semantic validators may already enforce these invariants outside JSON Schema. If so, this packet should be closed by exact tests demonstrating fail-closed behavior; the permissive schema then remains only a transport shape, not acceptance authority.
acceptance_for_closure: Each finding is either fixed in schema/validator or explicitly documented as intentionally enforced in deterministic semantic validation, with negative tests bound to current source identity.
